topics: Introduction to refrigeration and air conditioning
Definition of refrigeration and air conditioning
Relationship of refrigeration and air-conditioning fields
Ideal refrigeration cycle- Reversed Carnot cycle
Gas and Vapour as refrigerant in reversed Carnot cycle
Revisions of the reversed Carnot cycle- reversed Brayton cycle and simple vapour compression refrigeration cycle.
Simple aircraft refrigeration system with ram compression
Thermodynamic analysis of vapour compression and vapour absorption refrigeration systems.
representation of the cycle on T-s and P-h diagram
Use of refrigerant tables and charts
Effect of operating on COP suction line heat exchanger
Limitation of single stage refrigeration systems in achieving ultra-low temperature.
Cascade refrigeration system and Trans-critical refrigeration system (Numerical Problems to be limited to Refrigerants R134a, R32, R1234yf, R410A, R744, R718, R744)
desirable properties of refrigerant and absorbent pairs
Working of continuous vapour absorption system
Use of charts to calculate the performance of vapour absorption refrigeration system (Numerical problem limited to LiBr-Water absorption system)
Comparison of vapour absorption and vapour compression system.
commonly used refrigerants- HFC, HC,HFO and mixed refrigerants
desirable physical, chemical and thermodynamic properties of refrigerants.
Types of expansion devices – Constant pressure valve-Thermostatic expansion valve and capillary tube
Types of compressors in refrigeration systems
Properties of moist air- specific humidity.
wet bulb and thermodynamic wet bulb temperatures
year round air-conditioning systems – Representation on the Psychrometric chart and estimation of quantities.

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module. Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks. Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered. Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Define and describe the basic concepts and applications of refrigeration and air conditioning and analyse performance of ideal refrigeration cycles
Explain the principles and evaluate the efficiency of aircraft refrigeration systems
Perform Thermodynamic Analysis of Vapour Compression and Absorption Systems.
Explain and Select Appropriate Refrigerants and System Components
Analyse properties of moist air using psychrometric principles and chart and explain the working principles and applications of air washers and air-conditioning systems.
